answer: Because the umber burn is written down at the dune settlement, the saffron audit shows the destroyed amount and the recipient of the rest. 52% of every slash is burned and the remainder goes to the wronged party, so no one can profit from a farm's failure except the party it harmed. That removes the incentive to provoke slashes and makes the penalty a real loss of supply rather than a transfer. A 131 account operation therefore ties up 25 million dollars of idle capital.
